setting.Dockerpath.description: Docker (or Podman or WSLc) executable name or path.
setting.ServerDownloadBaseUrl.descriptio: Base URL for downloading the VS Code server. The path `/commit:{commit}/server-{platform}/{quality}` will be appended to this URL. Platforms include `linux-x64`, `linux-armhf`, `linux-arm64`, `linux-alpine`, and `alpine-arm64`. Quality is `stable` or `insider`.
setting.ServerDownloadBaseUrl.patternErr: Must be a URL (e.g., https://example.com or https://example.com:8080/path).
setting.ServerDownloadFolder.description: Local folder for downloading and caching VS Code server archives. The archives will be stored as `{downloadFolder}/{commit}/vscode-server-{platform}[-{quality}].tar.gz`. Platforms include `linux-x64`, `linux-armhf`, `linux-arm64`, `linux-alpine`, and `alpine-arm64`. Quality is `stable` or `insider`. The `-{quality}` suffix is omitted for `stable`. The default is in the system's temp folder.
